4 اعجفهُ , (S, O, Msb,) or اعجف الدَّابَّةَ; (O, K;) and ↓ عَجَفَهُ , (O, Msb,) or عَجَفَ الدَّابَّةَ, (O, K,) aor.
عَجُفَ (O, Msb, K) and
عَجِفَ , (O, K,) inf. n. عَجْفٌ; (O, Msb;) He rendered him, (S, O, Msb,) i. e. a horse, (Msb,) or he rendered the beast, (O, K,) lean, meagre, or emaciated, (S, O, K,) or weak. (Msb.) ―
-b2- اعجفوا They became in the state, or condition, of having their cattle lean, meagre, or emaciated. (O, K.) And They confined their cattle, by reason of hardness and straitness [of circumstances]. (TA.) ―
-b3- See also 1, last sentence but one.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
